description_en: Encrypts data by using the public key of an asymmetric CMK
description_zh: 使用非对称密钥进行加密
kebab_example: aliyun kms asymmetric-encrypt --plaintext SGVsbG8gd29ybGQ= --key-id key-hzz630494463ejqjx0000 --key-version-id 2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000 --algorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AsymmetricEncrypt

parameters.help_en: The plaintext to be encrypted. The value must be Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 要加密的明文，使用Base64编码
parameters.name: plaintext

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.

To access a key of another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the key. The key ARN is in the format of `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key version. The ID must be a globally unique identifier.

To obtain the key version ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/133966.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
密钥版本ID。密钥版本的全局唯一标识符。  

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/133966.html接口获取KeyVersionId（密钥版本ID）
parameters.name: key_version_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run feature.

true: enables the feature.

false (default): disables the feature.

The dry run feature is used to test the API call and verify the permissions on the specified resources and the validity of the request parameters. If you enable the dry run feature, KMS always returns a failed result and a failure reason. The failure reasons include the following:

DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter was not specified.

ValidationError: The specified parameters in the request are invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

CiphertextBlob.description_en: The ciphertext of the data that is encrypted. The value is Base64-encoded
CiphertextBlob.description_zh: 加密后的密文，使用Base64编码

KeyId.description_en: The ID of the key. If you specify an alias or an ARN of the key in the request, the ID of the key is returned
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥ID。如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是密钥别名、密钥ARN，在响应中也会返回密钥ID

KeyVersionId.description_en: The version number of the master key that is used to encrypt the plaintext
KeyVersionId.description_zh: 对明文数据进行加密的主密钥版本号

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
